items.title: COP31: The push to protect warming oceans reaches the negotiating table

sentences.en: From identifying marine life with a cup of seawater to drawing on Indigenous knowledge to prevent wildfires, scientists and communities showcased both cutting-edge and time-tested ways to protect nature at COP31 on Tuesday.

sentences.en: Yet turning innovation into action remains a challenge, with funding gaps persisting and ministers struggling to bridge divisions over fossil fuels and climate finance as negotiations enter their final days.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着谈判进入最后阶段，将创新转化为行动仍然是一项挑战，资金缺口持续存在，各国部长正努力弥合在化石燃料和气候融资问题上的分歧。

items.title: Five EU states announce plans for immigration ‘return hubs’ in Rwanda

sentences.en: Five EU states announce plans for immigration ‘return hubs’ in Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 五个欧盟国家宣布在卢旺达建立移民“遣返中心”的计划。

sentences.en: Germany, Austria, Netherlands, Denmark and Greece likely to face challenges to policy criticised as ‘grave moral failing’ Five EU member states have announced plans to set up an offshore centre in Rwanda for people with no legal right to stay in Europe, in a pilot scheme that is expected to face legal challenges and has been denounced as “a grave moral failing”.
sentences.zh: 德国、奥地利、荷兰、丹麦和希腊可能面临政策挑战，该政策被批评为“严重的道德败坏”五个欧盟成员国已宣布计划在卢旺达设立一个境外中心，用于安置无合法权利留在欧洲的人。该试点计划预计将面临法律挑战，并已被谴责为“严重的道德败坏”。

sentences.en: The five countries – Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Denmark and Greece – are the first to seek to use the EU’s newly agreed returns law that allows people who have exhausted all avenues of appeal against their removal from Europe to be sent to a third country.

items.title: Scheduling the removal of the kube-proxy IPVS backend

sentences.en: Scheduling the removal of the kube-proxy IPVS backend.
sentences.zh: 安排移除kube-proxy IPVS后端。

sentences.en: The ipvs backend for kube-proxy was an experiment in providing a service proxy implementation with better performance than the iptables backend.
sentences.zh: kube-proxy的ipvs后端是一项实验，旨在提供比iptables后端性能更好的服务代理实现。

sentences.en: While it succeeded in that goal, the kernel IPVS API has turned out to be a bad match for the Kubernetes Services API, and the ipvs backend was never able to implement all of the edge cases of Kubernetes Service functionality correctly.
sentences.zh: 虽然它成功实现了这一目标，但事实证明，内核IPVS API与Kubernetes Service API并不匹配，并且ipvs后端从未能够正确实现Kubernetes Service功能的全部边缘用例。

sentences.en: In Kubernetes 1.29, the project introduced the nftables backend for kube-proxy, which became GA in 1.33.
sentences.zh: 在Kubernetes 1.29中，该项目为kube-proxy引入了nftables后端，该后端在1.33中成为GA。

sentences.en: Part of the plan behind adding the nftables backend was the idea that it would eventually replace both the iptables and ipvs backends.
sentences.zh: 添加nftables后端的计划部分是基于这样一个想法：它最终将取代iptables和ipvs后端。

sentences.en: Because the ipvs backend in particular is complex, not 100% feature complete, and architecturally quite different from the other two backends (and thus more work to maintain), Kubernetes SIG Network decided to officially deprecate it as of Kubernetes 1.35 .
sentences.zh: 由于ipvs后端特别复杂，功能并不完全，并且在架构上与其他两个后端有很大不同（因此需要更多的工作来维护），Kubernetes SIG Network决定从Kubernetes 1.35开始正式弃用它。

sentences.en: Although it currently remains available in kube-proxy (with a warning about its deprecation), we (Kubernetes SIG Network) now plan to remove it in Kubernetes 1.40.
sentences.zh: 虽然它目前在kube-proxy中仍然可用（并附有关于其弃用的警告），但我们（Kubernetes SIG Network）现在计划在Kubernetes 1.40中将其移除。

sentences.en: All ipvs users should therefore be planning to migrate to either the nftables or iptables backends.
sentences.zh: 因此，所有ipvs用户都应计划迁移到nftables或iptables后端。

sentences.en: Why was the ipvs backend written?
sentences.zh: 为什么编写ipvs后端？

sentences.en: The ipvs backend was originally designed to fix two different kinds of performance problems in the iptables backend: First, iptables had problems with data plane latency (the speed at which clients could establish new connections to services), because kube-proxy would write a separate iptables rule to match each service IP, so every new connection would need to be matched against a long series of rules that was O(n) in the number of services in the cluster.
sentences.zh: ipvs后端最初的目的是为了解决iptables后端存在的两种不同类型的性能问题：首先，iptables存在数据平面延迟（客户端能够与服务建立新连接的速度）问题，因为kube-proxy会写入一条单独的iptables规则来匹配每个服务IP，因此每个新连接都需要与一系列较长的规则进行匹配，而这些规则的数量与集群中的服务数量成O(n)关系。

sentences.en: Second, it had an even larger problem with control plane latency (the speed at which kube-proxy could process changes to services and endpoints and update the data plane rules), because kube-proxy would rewrite the entire iptables ruleset every time any service or endpoint changed.
sentences.zh: 其次，它在控制层面延迟（kube-proxy处理服务和端点变化并更新数据层面规则的速度）方面存在更大的问题，因为每当有任何服务或端点发生变化时，kube-proxy都会重写整个iptables规则集。

sentences.en: While the list of rules itself was only O(n) in the total number of endpoints, the amount of time, RAM, and CPU that it took to process the updated ruleset grew faster than that.

sentences.en: Last week’s launch of AWS Emulator brings part of that work onto your own machine: developers and coding agents can exercise AWS API interactions, inspect results, and try again without provisioning cloud resources for every attempt.

sentences.zh: 我上周写了关于模拟器发布的内容，这是本期通讯的重点。

sentences.en: There are also new ways to isolate workloads on shared infrastructure, give an agent narrowly scoped access to a backend, and prepare search applications for a regional disruption.
sentences.zh: 还有一些新方法可以隔离共享基础设施上的工作负载，为代理提供对后端的有限访问权限，并为搜索应用程序做好应对区域性中断的准备。
